mechanisms.name: Piecewise CUDA graph capture and replay per batch descriptor
mechanisms.trigger: each call of a wrapped subgraph with a forward context whose runtime mode matches the wrapper
mechanisms.observable: a new batch descriptor captures a graph into the shared pool and returns live output; a known one replays and returns the weak-ref output; a mode mismatch or no forward context runs eagerly
mechanisms.note: The state machine matches, but only its own flows enter it. In the code each PiecewiseBackend subgraph is wrapped (one graph per piece); the model wraps support-torch-compile.call once, and cuda-graph-manager.run-pw-graph does not reach this interface. gc_disable on later pieces, last-piece weak_ref_output and the offloader sync and join are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: VllmBackend: Dynamo graph to piecewise compiled callable
mechanisms.trigger: Dynamo hands a traced graph to the backend, once per backend instance, on the first compile
mechanisms.observable: per-rank cache dir chosen, graph split, every non-splitting piece compiled for all ranges before return, cache index saved, VllmSerializableFunction returned; a second call asserts
mechanisms.note: Stage order and counters run as the code does. Splitting is a computed count, the serializable function is not built, and the v1 ngram-GPU cache disable is missing.

mechanisms.name: @support_torch_compile call routing
mechanisms.trigger: every forward call of a decorated model
mechanisms.observable: in order: plain forward (do_not_compile or skip_compiled), loaded AOT function, AOT artifact from disk, already-compiled guard-free dispatch, otherwise first compile
mechanisms.note: The branch order matches. The torch.compiler.is_compiling() bypass (compile done by an outer runner, e.g. TPU) is missing, and the eager-backend branch that turns AOT off is not visible in the steps.

mechanisms.name: Compile cache key from env, config, traced code and compiler
mechanisms.trigger: VllmBackend.__call__ with no configured cache_dir; first compile records every traced file through a patched inline_call_
mechanisms.observable: editing a traced source, changing a hashed env var or a config field gives a new torch_compile_cache/<sha256[:10]> directory and a recompile; cache_key_factors.json records the factors
mechanisms.note: Only config_hash comes from a real computation. env_hash, code_hash and compiler_hash default to constants (env0, code0, inductor) that a caller may override; traced_files and compile_factors don't exist in the model, so a source edit can't invalidate it.

mechanisms.name: Compile sizes and ranges: compile up front, pick by runtime shape
mechanisms.trigger: backend construction compiles or loads every range; each piece call reads the symbolic token count
mechanisms.observable: a token count in compile_sizes runs its exact-size artifact, otherwise the covering range; a count outside every range asserts; a static-shape piece uses its single compiled entry
mechanisms.note: Exact size, general range and out-of-range all run. Encoder pieces extend the last range to int32 max in the code; the warm-start load_all_ranges and the static-shape single-entry path are missing.

mechanisms.name: Per-rank compile artifact index: load, compile, store
mechanisms.trigger: CompilerManager.compile for each piece and range
mechanisms.observable: a key in vllm_compile_cache.py loads the artifact by handle without Inductor; a miss compiles and stores the handle unless the cache is disabled; the index is rewritten only when updated; a malformed value is ignored and recompiled
mechanisms.note: Hit, miss, store and disable run. The outdated-entry fallback in load and the torch force_disable_caches inputs to is_compile_cache_enabled are missing.

mechanisms.name: AOT compiled-function artifact with source verification
mechanisms.trigger: first forward of a module with VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE and the cache enabled
mechanisms.observable: a valid artifact at torch_aot_compile/<hash>/rank_i_j/model runs without Dynamo or Inductor; a changed traced source or corrupt file warns and recompiles (raises under VLLM_FORCE_AOT_LOAD); save goes through a temp file and atomic replace, and failure only warns
mechanisms.note: Load-or-compile runs from a key lookup. _verify_source_unchanged, the corrupt-file warning, VLLM_FORCE_AOT_LOAD and the atomic temp-file save are missing, and the two cache interfaces have no behavior of their own.

mechanisms.name: Post-grad pass manager: configured passes, then lowering and cleanup
mechanisms.trigger: Inductor runs the custom post-grad pass once per compiled piece and range
mechanisms.observable: passes selected from pass_config in fixed order and skipped per compile range, then cleanup, IR lowering, clone elimination, cleanup, and fix_functionalization always last; its uuid enters the Inductor cache key
mechanisms.note: Omits AddRMSNorm and RMSNormReshape canonicalization, split coalescing, scatter-split replacement, qk-norm-rope(-kvcache), MLA rope-cat, attention-quant and MLA attention-quant passes. The ordered tail is present, but configure() is merged into the call.

mechanisms.name: Fusion passes gated by compile range
mechanisms.trigger: for each pass and compile range, is_applicable_for_range
mechanisms.observable: fused decode kernels are compiled only for ranges ending at or below the pass's max token number; larger prefill ranges keep separate kernels; a disabled all-reduce fusion logs and skips
mechanisms.note: Only fuse_rope_kvcache has the range condition in the model; all-reduce and qk-norm-rope-kvcache gating is missing.

mechanisms.name: All-reduce + RMSNorm fusion selection
mechanisms.trigger: fuse_allreduce_rms pass construction and application; AITER variant on ROCm
mechanisms.observable: with TP > 1 and FlashInfer comm available, all-reduce followed by RMSNorm becomes one fused op up to a size limit; otherwise the pass disables itself and the graph is unchanged
mechanisms.note: The behavior is one branch on the input pattern list that returns a fixed replacement. It ignores tp_size, FlashInfer availability, max size, the disabled state and the AITER variant.

mechanisms.name: Norm and activation + quant fusion patterns by capability
mechanisms.trigger: fuse_norm_quant and fuse_act_quant passes during compile
mechanisms.observable: RMSNorm or SiLU-mul followed by FP8 or NVFP4 quant becomes a fused op; which patterns register depends on the epsilon, the op existing in _C, CUDA and SM100
mechanisms.note: Rated from step outlines without a line-by-line read. Capability conditions are modeled; matching works on a declared pattern list, not a graph.

mechanisms.name: RoPE and KV cache update fusion per attention layer
mechanisms.trigger: fuse_rope_kvcache, fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache and MLA cat passes during compile, on attention layers that support them
mechanisms.observable: decode-range rope then KV write becomes one fused op, with a static-Q quant variant; a layer without support registers no pattern
mechanisms.note: The plain rope+KV pass runs in the pipeline. The qk-norm and MLA pass classes aren't reached from the pass manager; only their fused ops exist as interfaces.

mechanisms.name: vLLM IR op provider dispatch by priority and argument support
mechanisms.trigger: every call of vllm.ir.ops.rms_norm, fused_add_rms_norm or gelu_and_mul_sparse outside lowering
mechanisms.observable: the first provider in the priority list whose supports_args accepts the arguments runs; native is appended when no provider supports all args; an empty list warns and uses native; an unsupported listed provider raises

mechanisms.name: IR op priority: user list + platform defaults, installed at worker start
mechanisms.trigger: KernelConfig.set_platform_defaults during config resolution; set_default in worker init
mechanisms.observable: with Inductor compile the default is native, without it vllm_c then native; VLLM_USE_OINK_OPS prepends oink; gelu uses triton on CUDA; user lists keep their order with platform entries appended without duplicates
mechanisms.note: The model holds the result as a fixed config value (ir-op-priority: native, triton+native), so mode NONE or another platform can't change it.

mechanisms.name: IR op lowering at compile time
mechanisms.trigger: the post-grad manager, after the fusion passes
mechanisms.observable: each vllm_ir node is replaced by the provider chosen from its fake args; leftovers warn; the priority list and provider source hashes enter the pass uuid
mechanisms.note: The interface is called from post-grad-pass-manager.call but has no behavior; no provider is selected at compile time.

mechanisms.name: Defunctionalization, unsafe clone elimination and post cleanup
mechanisms.trigger: the end of every post-grad pipeline run
mechanisms.observable: dead nodes removed and the graph topologically sorted, proven-safe clones dropped, auto_functionalized ops rewritten in place so no redundant copies reach the kernel; skipped on XPU
mechanisms.note: All three are called in order with no behavior; their effect on the graph or on copies isn't modeled.

mechanisms.name: maybe_inplace IR ops: input donation check before autograd
mechanisms.trigger: pre_grad_custom_pass, set up in configure_post_pass
mechanisms.observable: maybe_inplace overloads become the default overload; an activation used after a maybe_inplace call raises ValueError; donated graph inputs are recorded in the pass context

mechanisms.name: FX graph split at splitting ops
mechanisms.trigger: VllmBackend.__call__, unless Inductor partitioning is on
mechanisms.observable: submodules cut around attention ops; size() decomposed so torch.Size doesn't cross a boundary; getitem stays with its source; a partition with only an empty allocation merges into the previous one
mechanisms.note: Reduced to a piece count from num_layers. No splitting ops, size decomposition, getitem rule or empty merge.

mechanisms.name: Inductor-driven graph partition with per-partition CUDA graph wrappers
mechanisms.trigger: use_inductor_graph_partition with a piecewise CUDA graph mode
mechanisms.observable: no FX pre-split; Inductor partitions at splitting_ops during lowering and each partition gets a static graph wrapper through a process-level hook, set and cleared around the call

mechanisms.name: In-memory artifact dedup across isomorphic subgraphs
mechanisms.trigger: each backend compile, through a patched autograd_cache_key with normalized inputs
mechanisms.observable: a piece whose AOTAutograd key was already produced aborts compile with StopCompiling and reuses the loaded artifact, so 32 identical layers don't each produce a new artifact

mechanisms.name: Guard-free compile wrapper: compile once, then dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: the module's __call__; __init__ picks the guard policy
mechanisms.observable: guards are dropped outside stock mode, so the first call compiles and later calls never trace; with evaluate_guards the stance becomes fail_on_recompile after the first compile; the bytecode hook runs compiled code directly and refuses a graph captured inside the compiler
mechanisms.note: First-call and later-call paths run with one wrapper per module. The guard_filter_fn options from __init__ and the bytecode hook's refusal when CUDA graphs are on are missing.

mechanisms.name: Compile mode and compiler backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: CompilerManager construction and model setup from compilation_config
mechanisms.observable: inductor with standalone_compile selects the standalone adaptor, otherwise InductorAdaptor; eager returns the graph uncompiled; another name resolves the platform's compile backend; stock mode calls model.compile; MEGA AOT without standalone compile asserts
mechanisms.note: The three-way adaptor choice runs. The custom platform backend, the MEGA AOT assert, stock-mode model.compile and EagerAdaptor.compile are missing, and no behavior calls make-compiler.

mechanisms.name: Breakable CUDA graph: segments split by eager ops
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH: a decorated op runs inside an active capture outside FULL mode
mechanisms.observable: the current segment ends, the op runs eagerly on the capture stream and is recorded with weak-ref args, a new segment begins; replay runs graph and eager segments in order without entering the model

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph capture legality gate
mechanisms.trigger: before any capture; the model runner opens it for warmup and closes it after
mechanisms.observable: a capture attempted after warmup raises RuntimeError instead of silently capturing during serving
mechanisms.note: The check and setter are right, but no behavior calls the setter, so the gate only closes when a scenario seeds that state.

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph pool routing under sleep mode
mechanisms.trigger: each capture; profiling opens capture_outside_cumem_pool
mechanisms.observable: capture goes to the cuMem graph pool when sleep offloads graph memory, otherwise to the shared pool; NCCL's graph allocator points to the same pool; profiling graphs stay outside cuMem so they can be freed
mechanisms.note: Only set_graph_pool_id runs; the use_cumem_cudagraph_pool branch and the profiling exclusion are missing.

mechanisms.name: Compiler-managed static input buffers for CUDA graphs
mechanisms.trigger: cudagraph_copy_inputs with a CUDA graph mode
mechanisms.observable: symbolic-shape inputs are copied into fixed buffers before the call, so captured addresses stay valid; debug mode asserts addresses didn't move
mechanisms.note: The branch and the debug address check run; the copy into buffers is only a returned path.

mechanisms.name: Mega AOT artifact: all subgraph artifacts in one file
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT with AOT and standalone compile
mechanisms.observable: save bundles every piece's artifacts by submodule and range, deduplicated by content; warm start rebuilds PiecewiseBackends from bytes, skipping FX compile

mechanisms.name: Generated stitching code for the split graph
mechanisms.trigger: the end of VllmBackend.__call__, and warm-start reconstruction
mechanisms.observable: the split graph's top level is emitted as a Python function that calls submodules directly, replacing FX interpretation at serving time

mechanisms.name: Dynamic shape marking and constraints on first compile
mechanisms.trigger: the first compile of a decorated module, by dynamic_shapes_config type
mechanisms.observable: declared dims are marked backed, unbacked or size-oblivious, including the forward context's is_padding, so one compile serves every batch size
mechanisms.note: One step titled as marking dynamic dims, which only sets state. No type branch and no effect on shapes.

mechanisms.name: Per-component compile tags and multimodal encoder compile
mechanisms.trigger: set_model_tag around a component, is_encoder decoration, enable_if with should_torch_compile_mm_encoder
mechanisms.observable: backbone, draft head and encoder get separate cache prefixes and log tags; encoder compile time accumulates separately
mechanisms.note: Only the prefix input in the cache path; no encoder decision and no separate time.

mechanisms.name: Kernel JIT monitor after warmup
mechanisms.trigger: the end of compile_or_warm_up_model; afterward any Triton, CuTeDSL or TileLang JIT compile or autotune during inference
mechanisms.observable: a kernel compiled during serving logs a latency-spike warning, or raises in jit_monitor_mode=error, naming the kernel and its cause

mechanisms.name: GC freeze for serving and during CUDA graph capture
mechanisms.trigger: after warmup in workers, engine core and API server; around bulk capture
mechanisms.observable: static objects are frozen after a full collect; GC is frozen and disabled during capture so a kernel finalizer can't invalidate a graph, with VLLM_ENABLE_CUDAGRAPH_GC as opt-out
mechanisms.note: Named only in that interface's summary. No step freezes anything, and the capture-time freeze doesn't exist.

mechanisms.name: Implicit GPU sync check on the hot path
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK, armed after warmup, around execute_model and sample_tokens on the calling thread
mechanisms.observable: implicit CPU-GPU syncs and blocking copies warn or raise, except in gpu_sync_allowed regions and during compilation

mechanisms.name: Native kernel library loading per platform
mechanisms.trigger: current_platform.import_kernels() at import of _custom_ops, vllm_c and aiter_ops
mechanisms.observable: CUDA loads _C_stable_libtorch plus optional MoE and Qutlass libraries with a logged warning on failure; XPU loads only _moe_C; CPU x86 selects _C, _C_AVX512 or _C_AVX2 by ISA
mechanisms.note: Individual op bindings exist as interfaces (torch-bindings, cpu-torch-bindings, flashkda-registration), but nothing models which library set is available.

mechanisms.name: Python op wrappers and fake impls gated by registered ops
mechanisms.trigger: module import: hasattr(torch.ops.<lib>, op) guards for each register_fake; direct_register_custom_op for Python ops
mechanisms.observable: fake implementations exist only for ops in this build; a missing extension fails at first call with an attribute or RuntimeError, not at import; Python kernels get a low-overhead CUDA dispatch
mechanisms.note: Each op's wrapper-to-binding call is modeled; the build-dependent gate isn't, so every op is always present except where a behavior branches by itself.

mechanisms.name: Op wrappers choosing a backend by platform, shape or env
mechanisms.trigger: each call of a selecting wrapper
mechanisms.observable: cutlass_scaled_mm uses CUTLASS when B is 16-aligned off ROCm, else Triton; AWQ uses Triton with VLLM_USE_TRITON_AWQ; NVFP4 quant picks an 8x4 scale layout on trtllm with m <= 32; XPU and non-CUDA platforms branch before the kernel
mechanisms.note: cutlass_scaled_mm runs as written; the VLLM_USE_TRITON_AWQ branch has no config in the model; the remaining wrappers weren't read step by step.

mechanisms.name: FP8 GEMM backend predicates: DeepGEMM and FlashInfer block-scale
mechanisms.trigger: FP8 layer construction
mechanisms.observable: DeepGEMM and FlashInfer block-scale are eligible only for BF16 output with N % 64 == 0 and K % 128 == 0 on a supported SM; DeepGEMM is auto-disabled for listed model types on Blackwell
mechanisms.note: Availability gates exist. should_use_deepgemm_for_fp8_linear, the FlashInfer predicate and should_auto_disable_deep_gemm have no representation; the selector treats DeepGEMM as not installed.

mechanisms.name: DeepGEMM lazy import with vendored fallback and PDL
mechanisms.trigger: first DeepGEMM use
mechanisms.observable: site-packages deep_gemm is preferred, then the vendored copy; symbols resolve once; PDL is set per platform; a missing module yields None and a raising placeholder, and the E8M0 scale format follows
mechanisms.note: Only the scale format decision and the module check. Import order, vendored fallback and _apply_pdl are missing.

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer availability and lazy symbol binding
mechanisms.trigger: first call to has_flashinfer or to any wrapped FlashInfer function
mechanisms.observable: FlashInfer counts as available only with the package and cubins or a JIT toolchain; each wrapper resolves once and calls the fallback, which raises by default, when missing; feature probes require every symbol

mechanisms.name: TRTLLM versus FlashInfer attention choice
mechanisms.trigger: FlashInfer attention setup and metadata
mechanisms.observable: off with the CLI flag, batch-invariant mode, no artifactory, DCP prefill or an unsupported SM; SM90 and SM12x use TRTLLM for decode only; SM100 for both; further conditions on head counts and tokens
mechanisms.note: The attention area may model the outcome under its own interfaces; no interface there cites these functions.

mechanisms.name: FlashInfer precompiled kernels check at startup
mechanisms.trigger: on Hopper or newer with FlashInfer
mechanisms.observable: missing or version-mismatched flashinfer-cubin or jit-cache logs a warning pointing to `vllm download-kernels`

mechanisms.name: AITER capability gate and env-flag dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: each rocm_aiter_ops.is_*_enabled, and refresh_env_variables
mechanisms.observable: off ROCm, without the package or below CDNA 3 every gated method returns None; otherwise cached VLLM_ROCM_* flags decide; the MoE dispatch policy is read once

mechanisms.name: AITER runtime setup and tuned-kernel selection
mechanisms.trigger: AITER import and GEMM or MoE setup
mechanisms.observable: torch's HIP runtime is promoted to global scope for JIT extensions; RDNA4 has its own gate; GEMM picks Triton or CK by tuned-config tables; SITUV2 activation env is synced

mechanisms.name: XPU op registration from vllm_xpu_kernels
mechanisms.trigger: xpu_ops.register_ops_once on XPU
mechanisms.observable: Python kernels register once as custom ops with fake impls; external kernels back FP8, FP4 and MoE paths
mechanisms.note: Ops exist as interfaces; the once-only registration isn't modeled.

mechanisms.name: Triton availability detection and placeholder module
mechanisms.trigger: import of vllm.triton_utils
mechanisms.observable: Triton turns off unless exactly one non-CPU driver is active (0 is allowed under an empty visible-devices env, as in Ray init); a CPU build needs the cpu backend; without Triton a placeholder keeps decorators importable
mechanisms.note: ir-op.impl-supports-args names HAS_TRITON as a fixed assumption.

mechanisms.name: Platform override registry for Triton kernels
mechanisms.trigger: register_kernels at platform setup, then every kernel[grid](...) launch
mechanisms.observable: every module attribute and JIT warmup owner holding the kernel is rebound; launches route to the implementation by keyword or positional order, and unexpected keywords raise

mechanisms.name: CPU replacements for Triton kernels
mechanisms.trigger: CPU platform setup
mechanisms.observable: slot mapping, Eagle, rejection sampling and expand kernels run as native CPU ops
mechanisms.note: Wrappers exist with no caller; the CPU platform's register_kernels call isn't modeled.

mechanisms.name: Skip Triton autotuning: first valid config
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_TRITON_FORCE_FIRST_CONFIG, installed from env_override
mechanisms.observable: Autotuner.run launches the first config that doesn't raise OutOfResources or a compile error, caches the index per key and logs it once; if none is valid it raises

mechanisms.name: Helion kernels with pre-tuned per-GPU configs
mechanisms.trigger: @register_kernel on import of a Helion op module; config picker on call
mechanisms.observable: configs load by canonical GPU name; no configs disables the kernel with a warning and calling it raises; the picker selects a CaseKey by shape; without HOP it registers a vllm_helion custom op
mechanisms.note: Registration and selection run for silu_mul_fp8 only; six other ops have configs in the tree. HOP-false custom-op registration isn't modeled. Outside vllm/kernels/helion only collect_env and import_utils mention helion, so no serving path imports it.

mechanisms.name: Sparse indexer top-K kernel selection
mechanisms.trigger: each persistent_topk op call
mechanisms.observable: more than 64 rows with long sequences and enough shared memory uses sampled top-K; above 32 rows the filtered kernel; otherwise persistent with a size-based vector width and occupancy-checked block count
mechanisms.note: The binding is present; selection is at most named. Not read step by step.

mechanisms.name: CPU attention ISA dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: the backend's isa hint on each cpu_attention_with_kv_cache; generated switch per head dim and KV dtype
mechanisms.observable: hint maps to an ISA enum and a kernel instantiation; AMX-FP8 is also confirmed by CPUID at runtime since a build can run on a CPU without it
mechanisms.note: Rated from names and summaries; the hint-to-enum switch and runtime AMX-FP8 check weren't confirmed in the steps.

mechanisms.name: Native cuMem create, map, unmap and release
mechanisms.trigger: CuMemAllocator sleep and wake, through python_create_and_map and python_unmap_and_release
mechanisms.observable: VA is reserved once; physical memory maps at granularity (ROCm in chunks from VLLM_ROCM_SLEEP_MEM_CHUNK_SIZE, default 256 MB) with rollback on partial failure; unmap releases physical memory while the VA stays
mechanisms.note: Sleep and wake are modeled at the Python level by another area; the native mapping, chunking and rollback aren't.

mechanisms.name: NUMA binding of worker and engine processes
mechanisms.trigger: --numa-bind when a worker or EngineCore process starts
mechanisms.observable: the multiprocessing executable is swapped for a numactl wrapper binding to the GPU's node, with optional CPU core lists on PCT SKUs; args are probed and dropped if impossible; spawn is forced

mechanisms.name: Multiprocessing start method enforcement
mechanisms.trigger: get_mp_context before each process launch
mechanisms.observable: spawn is forced with a logged reason when in a Ray actor, with NUMA binding, after CUDA or XPU init, or in WSL

mechanisms.name: CPU OMP thread binding and torch thread counts
mechanisms.trigger: CPU worker launch; worker device init
mechanisms.observable: each rank gets a CPU list with iomp, gomp or plain OMP env vars; torch runtime threads follow the cgroup CPU limit

mechanisms.name: Memory profiling around a dummy forward
mechanisms.trigger: KV cache sizing during worker init
mechanisms.observable: baseline snapshot, torch peak and non-torch growth separate weights, peak activations and runtime memory, which together decide the KV cache budget
mechanisms.note: The peak is a formula on token count with assumptions; snapshots are phase constants, not measured subtraction.

mechanisms.name: Release cached device memory under UMA pressure
mechanisms.trigger: model loading on an integrated GPU
mechanisms.observable: with enough releasable bytes and low system free memory, synchronize and empty_cache return memory to the OS before thrashing

mechanisms.name: Native MWAITX spin wait for shared-memory polling
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_USE_SPINLOOP_EXT in the shm_broadcast reader and writer
mechanisms.observable: on AMD CPUs with MONITORX the wait sleeps on the metadata cache line until written or timed out, cutting CPU burn; otherwise it polls; if the extension doesn't load the env var is disabled

mechanisms.name: Native batched block file IO for KV tiering
mechanisms.trigger: filesystem tier lookup, store and load
mechanisms.observable: O_DIRECT reads and writes without the GIL, creating parent dirs and reporting num_succeeded on partial failure
mechanisms.note: Tiering managers exist in scheduler-kv; nothing cites this native layer.

mechanisms.name: Compile timers, profiling-run assertion and depyf dump
mechanisms.trigger: around every compile and first profiling run
mechanisms.observable: compile and encoder times accumulate into CompilationTimes; a backend compile during the profiling run asserts; a debug dump path writes depyf output and transformed code

mechanisms.name: Compilation counters
mechanisms.trigger: inline at each compile, cache and capture step
mechanisms.observable: graphs seen, backend and Inductor compiles, cache updates, AOT loads and CUDA graph captures grow; expect() checks exact deltas

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph usage stats table
mechanisms.trigger: cudagraph_metrics on; each observation, logged periodically
mechanisms.observable: a table of unpadded tokens, padded tokens, paddings, runtime mode and count shows padding waste

mechanisms.name: Inductor lazy-init pre-trigger and atomic artifact save
mechanisms.trigger: end of warmup; artifact save on torch older than 2.10
mechanisms.observable: Inductor's once-per-process init runs during warmup even on a cache hit, so its CUDA syncs can't trip the sync check on a later compile; artifacts save atomically so concurrent ranks don't corrupt them

mechanisms.name: NCCL environment pinning per communicator
mechanisms.trigger: pin_nccl_env before the process's first NCCL call; unpinned_nccl_env around shared communicators
mechanisms.observable: pins apply to this process's own communicators through NCCL_NO_CACHE; communicators shared with other processes are created without them

mechanisms.name: Size-aware LRU cache with pinning and stats
mechanisms.trigger: users such as the multimodal processor cache and LoRA manager
mechanisms.observable: eviction skips pinned keys, put_if_fits refuses oversized values, and hit-ratio stats report totals or deltas
mechanisms.note: Owned by other areas at the use sites; the shared cache class isn't modeled on its own, and those behaviors weren't read.

mechanisms.name: Optional kernel package gates: B12x, HPC, Humming
mechanisms.trigger: module import or first use
mechanisms.observable: each package adds kernels only when installed; B12x supplies warmup token counts and packed weight reuse; HPC warns when missing; Humming is patched and gets per-device locks
mechanisms.note: The selector's summary states these aren't installed in the modeled deployment; no gate runs.

mechanisms.name: Layerwise NVTX tracing
mechanisms.trigger: enable_layerwise_nvtx_tracing
mechanisms.observable: module-level NVTX ranges with tensor shapes appear in profiles, including around the compiled module
